# Migration Guidance & Regulatory Landscape

Covers government mandates, compliance timelines, and sector-specific migration
guidance for PQC adoption. See [citations.md](../citations.md) for full source
details.

## U.S. Federal Requirements

### National Security Memorandum 10 (NSM-10) — May 4, 2022

Presidential directive establishing the 2035 target for transitioning federal
systems to quantum-resistant cryptography [25]. Directs NIST and NSA to develop
PQC standards.

### OMB Memorandum M-23-02 — November 18, 2022

Federal agency PQC migration directive [24]:
- Mandates cryptographic inventory focused on high-value assets and high-impact systems
- Annual manual inventory requirement
- Acknowledges harvest-now-decrypt-later threat
- Estimated government-wide cost: $7.1 billion over 2025-2035 (est.)

**Caveat:** PDF not machine-readable; details from secondary sources [24].

### NSA CNSA 2.0 — September 2022

Commercial National Security Algorithm Suite 2.0 timeline for National Security
Systems (NSS) [11]:

| Deadline | Requirement |
|----------|-------------|
| December 31, 2025 | Existing NSS must meet CNSA 1.0 or request waiver |
| January 1, 2027 | All new NSS acquisitions must be CNSA 2.0 compliant |
| 2030 | All deployed NSS software/firmware must use CNSA 2.0 signatures |
| 2031 | Vast majority of NSS cryptography must be quantum-resistant |
| 2033 | Final mandatory compliance date for most system types |
| 2035 | Target for full transition |

Approved algorithms: ML-KEM (key exchange), ML-DSA (signatures) [11].
NSA position: QKD "not a practical security solution" for national security
information; PQC preferred [40].

**Caveat:** CNSA 2.0 FAQ PDF returned 403; timeline from discovery agent
cross-referencing multiple secondary sources [11][40].

### NIST IR 8547 — Transition Roadmap

Initial Public Draft published November 12, 2024 [12]:
- **By 2030:** Algorithms at ≤112-bit security (RSA-2048, ECC P-256) deprecated
- **By 2035:** All quantum-vulnerable public-key algorithms disallowed in NIST standards

### CISA Guidance

Joint guidance with NSA and NIST on quantum readiness [31]:
- Quantum-readiness roadmap
- Cryptographic inventory guidance
- Focus on high-impact systems and sensitive data first
- Automated PQC discovery/inventory tools strategy (August 15, 2024)

**Caveat:** CISA page returned 403 [31]; data from discovery agent.

## UK Requirements

### NCSC — PQC Migration Timelines

Three-phase approach [10]:

| Phase | Deadline | Activities |
|-------|----------|------------|
| Planning & Discovery | 2028 | Define migration goals, full discovery exercise, initial migration plan, identify supplier dependencies and investments |
| Priority Migrations | 2031 | Complete highest-priority PQC migration activities, prepare infrastructure for quantum-secure systems |
| Full Completion | 2035 | Complete migration of all systems, services, and products |

Priority order [10]:
1. Services processing most valuable/long-lived data
2. Systems with long-lived hardware dependencies
3. Critical communications and system infrastructure
4. Enterprise PKI (new PQC root-of-trust)
5. Internet-facing services using standardized protocols (TLS priority)

Sector-specific notes [10]:
- **Banking/telecoms:** Expect earlier migration focus with international alignment
- **ICS/OT:** Special attention for resource-constrained, non-upgradeable devices
- **SMEs:** Migration happens "seamlessly, as services are updated by their vendors"

NCSC frames PQC migration as "activities central to good cyber security practice" [10].

## EU Requirements

### Cyber Resilience Act (Regulation 2024/2847)

"World's first comprehensive piece of legislation to set mandatory cybersecurity
standards for products with digital elements" [23]:

| Deadline | Requirement |
|----------|-------------|
| End of 2024 | CRA applicable |
| 2027 | Full CRA enforcement; products must support quantum-safe firmware updates by default |
| 2030 | High-risk use cases must achieve quantum-secure status |
| 2035 | Complete migration away from quantum-vulnerable cryptography |

Requirements [23]:
- "Security by design" and "state-of-the-art" crypto agility
- CBOM (Cryptographic Bill of Materials) maintenance
- EU roadmap released June 23, 2025

## Sector-Specific Migration Timelines

### Enterprise Migration Duration Estimates

Academic research estimates enterprise migration timelines [39]:

| Enterprise Size | Estimated Duration |
|----------------|-------------------|
| Small | 5-7 years |
| Medium | 8-12 years |
| Large | 12-15+ years |

Assumptions: vendors deliver PQC products within 2-3 years, cryptographic
discovery within 1 year, phased execution 2-4 years [39].

**Critical gap:** 12-15 year large enterprise migration timeline vs. 5-10 year
CRQC arrival estimates creates a guaranteed exposure window [39].

### Financial Sector

FS-ISAC roadmap: 2028-2030 expected regulation, 3-5 years behind federal
timeline. Driver: 7-10+ year data retention requirements create HNDL exposure.

### Healthcare

HIPAA evolution expected but not yet mandated. Extended timelines due to
compliance/audit cycles. 50+ year record confidentiality for genomic data creates
critical long-term vulnerability.

### Government

Most aggressive timeline via CNSA 2.0 (2027 new acquisitions, 2033 final
compliance) [11]. Military quantum threat assessment emphasizes allied
preparedness [41].

## Gaps and Limitations

- CNSA 2.0 timeline from secondary sources; primary NSA FAQ PDF returned 403 [11]
- OMB M-23-02 cost estimate ($7.1B) from secondary sources; PDF not readable [24]
- DISA has no published PQC-specific STIG as of this research; future STIGs
  expected to incorporate CNSA 2.0 and FIPS 203/204/205
- Financial and healthcare sector timelines are projections, not binding mandates
- Enterprise migration duration estimates [39] are from academic modeling, not
  empirical data
- EO 14306 (June 2025) reportedly reduced some PQC procurement mandates from
  prior EO 14144, but specific impacts unclear from available sources
